welcome: All aboard, my little friend! Let’s take the number train to twenty!

introductions.text: This is 11. Say it with me. 11!
This is 12. Say it with me. 12!
This is 13. Say it with me. 13!
This is 14. Say it with me. 14!
This is 15. Say it with me. 15!
This is 16. Say it with me. 16!
This is 17. Say it with me. 17!
This is 18. Say it with me. 18!
This is 19. Say it with me. 19!
This is 20. Say it with me. 20!

tracing: Let’s write [number]. First [first digit], then [second digit]. Together, [number]!
quantities: Here are [number] apples. Let’s count them together.
transition: Choo choo! The sun is setting. Next stop, the ocean! Let’s discover sixteen to twenty.
completion: You finished the one to twenty adventure! See you on the next one!
chapters: Train teaching and tracing: 11–15. Optional continuation to ocean teaching, bubbles and exploration: 16–20. No tracing or mandatory quiz in the ocean.
chapterEnd: You explored eleven to fifteen! Shall we visit the ocean, or finish for now?

ocean.quantities: Here are ten fish. Watch the next fish join them.
ocean.total: [Sixteen / Seventeen / Eighteen / Nineteen / Twenty] fish altogether!
ocean.bubble: Your turn! Tap a glowing bubble.
ocean.explore: Pick any number and see its fish! Tap the tick when you are ready to finish.
